description: For an agent with no person to approve a browser login: opens a Runtime account and its first top-up, paid in USDC on Base, Solana or Tempo. No free trial: the account gets its key only once the payment lands. Answers with an address per network, the exact amount to send and a claim code, shown once: keep it secret, it is the only way to the account. Send exactly that amount from any wallet, then call runtime_wallet_claim with the claim code. Opening an account means agreeing to https://withruntime.com/legal/terms for whoever you act for.

usd.description: Dollars of credit to buy: $10 to $500 in an account's first week.

name: runtime_wallet_open
title: Open a Runtime account paid with a wallet
